reuse.why: Adds a new getRangeAmount and routes getScheduledAmount through it, but the server sites keep their own missing/number/range dispatch instead of calling the existing getScheduledAmount that already decides all three cases.

duplication.why: The range rule itself is now in one function, yet the surrounding null/number/range ternary stays copied at five sites alongside the identical dispatch in getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, where schedule amount logic belongs.

scope.why: Touches only the range-amount sites, comments, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A future change to the range rule is one edit, but a change to the missing-amount handling still has to be repeated at every site.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts createScheduleList, forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions call getRangeAmount inside their own dispatch rather than getScheduledAmount

one_place.where: getRangeAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount and every server/preview site
